companies.name: イノベーティブ・ソリューションズ&サポート

relations.text: ISSCの3大顧客の一社(2024年9月期に売上の7%)。同時に競合でもある
relations.text_en: One of IS&S's three largest customers (7% of FY2024 revenue), and also a competitor

source.label: Innovative Solutions & Support 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: In the fiscal year ended September 30, 2024, our three largest customers, Pilatus, Textron and Honeywell accounted for 23%, 7% and 7% of total revenue, respectively.

relations.text: AIROが航空電子機器の納入先OEMとしてハネウェルを挙げる
relations.text_en: AIRO supplies avionics to OEMs including Honeywell

source.label: AIRO Group 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also serve as an avionics supplier for OEMs, including Robinson Helicopters, Pilatus, Honeywell, and Joby Aviation.

relations.text: ハネウェルなどのエンジンメーカーがアフターサービスを委託する大口顧客
relations.text_en: Engine makers including Honeywell subcontract aftermarket work to it

source.label: StandardAero 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Aircraft engine OEMs, including GE Aerospace, CFM International, Rolls-Royce, Honeywell, Pratt & Whitney and Safran in addition to providing authorizations to service the engines they manufacture, are also significant customers as a result of subcontracting aftermarket services to us for contracts they have with their end customers.

companies.name: バーティカル・エアロスペース

relations.text: 主要な供給元・航空宇宙パートナーとしてハネウェルを挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Honeywell among key suppliers and aerospace partners

source.label: Vertical Aerospace 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: A number of our key suppliers, including Honeywell and Syensqo, are based in, or have substantial engineering resources located in, the U.S. and are also actively involved in the defense industry.

relations.text: ボーイング機の航空電子機器の独占ライセンスと資産をハネウェルから取得(2024年12月)
relations.text_en: Took an exclusive license and assets for Boeing avionics product lines from Honeywell (December 2024)

source.label: HEICO 10-K(2025年10月期)
source.quote: In December 2024, the Company, through a subsidiary of HFSC, entered into an exclusive license agreement and acquired certain assets to support the Boeing 777 AIMS (Airplane Information Management System) and Boeing 737NG/P-8/E-7 VIA (Versatile Integrated Avionics) product lines from Honeywell International.

companies.sub: 航空部品の流通・整備

relations.text: ハネウェルの燃料制御システムの資産購入・ライセンス契約
relations.text_en: Asset purchase and license agreement for Honeywell fuel control systems

source.label: VSE 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On September 27, 2023, our Aviation segment entered into an Asset Purchase and License Agreement with Honeywell International Inc.

relations.text: ハネウェル傘下のUOPと供給契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Supply agreement with Honeywell affiliate UOP

source.label: ESS Tech 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: On September 21, 2023, we signed a Supply Agreement with UOP LLC ("UOP"), an affiliate of Honeywell International Inc.

companies.name: ソルスティス・アドバンスト・マテリアルズ

relations.text: 先端素材事業を2025年10月に分離・独立させた会社
relations.text_en: The advanced materials business spun off in October 2025

source.label: Honeywell 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On October 30, 2025, the Company completed the spin-off of its Advanced Materials business into an independent, publicly traded company named Solstice Advanced Materials, Inc. (Solstice).

relations.text: 2018年に分離した会社。環境債務の一部をハネウェルに支払う契約が続く
relations.text_en: Spun off in 2018; still pays Honeywell for certain environmental liabilities

source.label: Resideo 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: In connection with the Spin-Off, we entered into an agreement with Honeywell, pursuant to which we have obligations to make cash payments to Honeywell for certain Honeywell environmental liabilities ("Reimbursement Agreement").

relations.text: ハネウェルが大株主の量子コンピューター会社。ハネウェルは初期の顧客でもある
relations.text_en: Honeywell-backed quantum computing company; Honeywell was also an early customer

source.label: Quantinuum S-1(2026年5月)
source.quote: Honeywell has also served as both a testing ground for our tools and as an early customer, deploying our solutions in its products.

relations.text: 2025年に約22億ドルで買収。英Johnson Mattheyの触媒事業の買収も合意
relations.text_en: Bought for $2.2 billion in 2025; also agreed to buy Johnson Matthey's catalyst business

source.label: Honeywell 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In the second quarter of 2025, we acquired Sundyne for total consideration of $2.2 billion, net of cash acquired, as well as announced our agreement to acquire Johnson Matthey's Catalyst Technologies business segment for £1.8 billion.

source.label: Honeywell 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In the second quarter of 2025, we acquired Sundyne for total consideration of $2.2 billion, net of cash acquired, as well as announced our agreement to acquire Johnson Matthey's Catalyst Technologies business segment for £1.8 billion.
